svg.aria-label: The lit-review mode of the paper skill. Boxes: Intake: you confirm (stop); Literature strategist: each source confirmed by a live lookup (agent, only when needed); Literature strategist, theme run: search theme 1 (agent, only when needed); Literature strategist, theme runs: each other search theme, all at once (agent, only when needed); Session: each DOI or arXiv ID resolved once, the proceedings page of an entry with neither read (script); Literature strategist, resumed with the identifier check: titles resolved, strict: a failing identifier corrected or removed (agent, only when needed); Literature strategist, merge run, after the theme runs: removes the duplicates, runs the quality gates over the merged set, writes the one review (agent, only when needed); You review the sources, optional (stop); Session: each corrected or added entry's DOI or arXiv ID resolved again (script); A reference that cannot be confirmed (stop); Script: the entries added to the .bib, when a .tex is given (script).
svg.title: The lit-review mode of the paper skill.
